content.short: Polygon zkEVM is the first zero-knowledge scaling solution that is fully equivalent to an EVM.
content.description: Polygon zkEVM is an EVM-equivalent ZK rollup scaling solution. Existing smart contracts, developer tooling, and wallets work seamlessly. It uses zero-knowledge proofs to lower costs and boost throughput while inheriting Ethereum’s base security. Web3 developers can build dApps on zkEVM just as on Ethereum by switching to a zkEVM RPC provider for higher throughput and lower fees. Developers deploy contracts to zkEVM, and users can deposit assets from Ethereum and transact off-chain, with transactions grouped into batches attested by zero-knowledge proofs.
